ctx.x: . . . I was doing a lot of those things, like stage-band clinics with a really nice group. Sometimes Michael Moore would be the bass player. Phil Wilson from

Berklee [College of Music]. John LaPorta. Another guy named Wes Hensel, who has died. You knew all those guys. That would be the faculty. Marvin Stamm was in it at various times. I did a lot of those things. Then Jimmy and I worked some gigs together. I worked at a place called the Strollers Club, where they had a British group doing . . . items.q: We worked a lot together. We were really very close.

ctx.x: We worked a lot together. We were really very close.
